table_description: Fact table recording every item returned to a physical store. Each row is one returned line item. At SF100TCL scale this contains approximately 30 billion rows. Return transactions reference the original STORE_SALES ticket number, allowing return-to-sale matching.
use_cases: Return rate analysis by category, brand, or item
Return reason analysis using REASON dimension
Financial impact of returns (refunded cash, store credit, reversed charges)
data_quality_notes: SR_RETURNED_DATE_SK can be NULL — filter carefully for date-bounded analyses.
SR_TICKET_NUMBER links back to STORE_SALES.SS_TICKET_NUMBER for matching returns to original sales.
SR_CUSTOMER_SK can be NULL for anonymous returns.
SR_RETURN_AMT is the gross return amount. SR_NET_LOSS is the net financial loss including fees.
SR_STORE_CREDIT is granted store credit, SR_REFUNDED_CASH is actual cash back — these are mutually exclusive in most cases.
SR_REASON_SK joins to REASON table for why the item was returned.
Return rate = SUM(SR_RETURN_QUANTITY) / SUM(SS_QUANTITY) when joined with STORE_SALES.

table_columns.name: SR_RETURNED_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to DATE_DIM.D_DATE_SK. Date of return. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: SR_RETURN_TIME_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to TIME_DIM.T_TIME_SK. Time the return was processed. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: SR_ITEM_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to ITEM.I_ITEM_SK. Part of composite primary key with SR_TICKET_NUMBER.

table_columns.name: SR_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER.C_CUSTOMER_SK. Customer making the return. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: SR_CDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_DEMOGRAPHICS.CD_DEMO_SK.

table_columns.name: SR_HDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS.HD_DEMO_SK.

table_columns.name: SR_ADDR_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_ADDRESS.CA_ADDRESS_SK. Customer address.

table_columns.name: SR_STORE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to STORE.S_STORE_SK. Store where the return occurred.

table_columns.name: SR_REASON_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to REASON.R_REASON_SK. Reason code for the return.

table_columns.name: SR_TICKET_NUMBER
table_columns.description: Original sale ticket number. Links to STORE_SALES.SS_TICKET_NUMBER.

table_columns.name: SR_RETURN_QUANTITY
table_columns.description: Number of units returned.

table_columns.name: SR_RETURN_AMT
table_columns.description: Gross return amount before fees. Primary return value field.

table_columns.name: SR_RETURN_TAX
table_columns.description: Tax portion of the return amount.

table_columns.name: SR_RETURN_AMT_INC_TAX
table_columns.description: Total return amount including tax.

table_columns.name: SR_FEE
table_columns.description: Restocking or processing fee charged to customer on return.

table_columns.name: SR_RETURN_SHIP_COST
table_columns.description: Shipping cost associated with the return.

table_columns.name: SR_REFUNDED_CASH
table_columns.description: Cash refunded to customer.

table_columns.name: SR_REVERSED_CHARGE
table_columns.description: Credit card charge reversal amount.

table_columns.name: SR_STORE_CREDIT
table_columns.description: Store credit issued instead of cash refund.

table_columns.name: SR_NET_LOSS
table_columns.description: Net financial loss to the retailer from this return. Key metric for return impact analysis.
